text:
Anya: Quick sync — we need a tight storyline for the pricing page update. Thinking we frame tiers by a clear value metric (inference units / seat / embed-units). Also want a compact estimator widget and an FAQ rewrite to make metered vs committed clear. timelines? 
Matt: +1 on value metric focus. Can we avoid 'tokens' in public copy? maybe use 'inference units' or 'compute credits' so it's customer-friendly. 
Sahil: Agree on friendly language. Need 2 worked examples: a low-volume SaaS app and a high-throughput agent. Those will make the calc believable. I can draft numbers. 
Lucy: We should run a short webinar to walk through the estimator for early adopters. 20 min demo + 10 min Q. Can do week of May 15th. 
Anya: Perfect. Lucy can you own the webinar invite + runbook? @Lucy 
Lucy: Yep, I'll own. Will add slides + quick GIF of calculator in action. 
Priya: For inbound routing: recommend rule-based triage — estimator outputs a 'project size' tag. If > $3k/mo -> route to sales; if 0-3k -> marketing-led nurture + self-serve. We should add a nudge for 'book a cost review' after calc. 
Matt: Tidy. Can we capture that as a simple rule in the docs? e.g.: ``if estimator_monthly_cost >= 3000 then route:sales else route:marketing`` 
Sahil: Minor UX ask — show both monthly and per-10k tokens equivalents so technical users are happy. Keep default focus on monthly. 
Anya: For the FAQ, let's prune long technical answers. Focus on: how billing works, difference between metered vs committed, predictable SLAs for Dedicated, and how to get a cost estimate. I'll rework Qs and ping for reviews. 
Priya: Also add a short blurb about discounts for annual committed capacity and a link to request a quote. 
OpsBot: Routing doc updated: https://redwood.atlassian.org/pricing-routing (edited) 
Lucy: For webinar sign-up — small microsurvey: "What's your expected avg daily inference calls?" to help segment. 
Matt: A/B test two hero copylines on pricing page: "Pay for what you use" vs "Predictable throughput, lower cost" — measure clicks to estimator + demo signups. 
Anya: OK action list — 1) Lucy: webinar runbook + slides (due 1755600000), 2) Sahil: worked examples + calc numbers (due 1755588000), 3) Priya: routing rules + copy for 'book a review' (due 1755592000), 4) Matt: A/B copy variants + experiment setup (due 1755595000), 5) Anya: FAQ draft + final copy pass (due 1755598000). Anyone object? 
Sahil: All good from eng side. I'll need a quick review cycle for numbers. 
Lucy: Sounds good. I'll set calendar invite and add a short rehearsal the week prior. :thumbsup: 
Anya: Thanks team. I'll collate and send a single doc by EOD tomorrow.
